title: fix(runtime): a refused package publish no longer unhides the package's app
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6jtRVeUuKb22cFEsTLMdwn)_
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cauig1S7BsXuP9s5ed

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：「全部发布」(`POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts`) 只有在发布结果没有任何拒绝时（`outcome` 为 `published` 或 `nothing_to_publish`）才把包里隐藏的应用改成可见；被拒、结果值不认识或缺 `outcome` 时一律不改。
- 为什么改：实测：后面一个草稿被拒、整批回滚（返回 `refused`、`publishedCount: 0`）后，运营刻意隐藏的应用仍被改成可见、进了所有人的启动器，还广播了重载。ADR-0067 D2 明说「不允许部分可见性切换」。
- 风险与回滚：只在 runtime 一处加白名单判断，生产方不动。没有草稿的增量包发布（ADR-0045 §3，切换本身就是发布）照常切换。最坏情况是该显示的应用没显示，重跑一次发布即可（幂等）；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` 中 `PUBLISH_OUTCOMES_THAT_FLIP` 及切换块 `if` 的第一行条件；`packages-publish-drafts-change-note.integration.test.ts` 末尾新增的 `[#32455]` 一组（真实接口 + SQLite）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local src/domains/packages-publish-drafts-change-note.integration.test.ts`，预期 10 passed，其中 4 个以 `[#32455]` 开头。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #32455

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

After `publishPackageDrafts` returns, the door runs the ADR-0045 §3 visibility flip: it sets `_unpublished: false` on every app bound to the package that is stored with `_unpublished: true`, reports them under `unhiddenApps`, and announces them on `metadata:reloaded`. It never looked at what the publish answered. A refused batch also answers `200`, so a refused publish unhid an app the operator had kept hidden.

ADR-0067 D2, verbatim: "any failure rolls the whole commit back — no half-built app, no orphan rows, no partial visibility flip … The visibility flip (ADR-0045 `hidden:false`) is part of the same transaction". ADR-0045 §3: "`publish-drafts` for an additive package becomes the visibility flip (+ optional seed re-run); for mutation packages it keeps its current promote semantics."

The flip now runs only when `outcome` names a publish that refused nothing. That is the seat's step-0 ruling (Claim amendment 6810610771, predicate A, the fail-closed allow-list):

| `publishPackageDrafts` answer | flip before | flip after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `published` (drafts promoted, none refused) | yes | yes |
| `nothing_to_publish` (no drafts; the ADR-0045 additive publish, where the flip IS the publish) | yes | yes |
| `refused` (pre-flight violation, or the ADR-0067 D2 rollback at a later draft, including #32396's undo-failed partial) | **yes** | **no** |
| an `outcome` the declaration does not name, or no `outcome` at all | yes | **no** (fail closed) |
| thrown (the door's outer `catch`, `errorFromThrown`) | no | no (unchanged) |

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`: a module constant `PUBLISH_OUTCOMES_THAT_FLIP`, typed against the declared `PublishPackageDraftsResponse['outcome']`, and one condition in front of the flip's existing capability probe. When it is false nothing is read or written: `unhiddenApps` and `unhideError` stay absent. The announce and the route-level seed back-fill are not edited. On `refused`, `published` is `[]`, so with no flip there is nothing to announce. No log on the skip: the caller is told by `outcome` and `failed[]`, and AGENTS.md "Degradation log levels" says a failure handed to the caller is not a degradation.
- The producer (`metadata-protocol`) is unchanged: `outcome` is already a required member of `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema`, and the producer's pinned invariant is `refused` if and only if `failed.length > 0`.
- Rulings in the flip block, kept and untouched: #4829 (the gate is `_unpublished`, never `hidden`) and the #6190 ruling, Option A (the read and the write stay env-wide).

## Tests

New pins:

- `packages-publish-drafts-change-note.integration.test.ts`, a new top-level `describe` in the route's real-door harness (`HttpDispatcher.handlePackages`, the real `publishPackageDrafts`, ObjectQL, SqlDriver over on-disk better-sqlite3). The app is saved straight to active with `_unpublished: true`, and each case reads the stored row back.
  - A publish refused at a later draft (`environment` channel, where the publish-time gate runs; an autonumber format `QJ{YYYYMM}-{0000}`): `200`, `outcome: refused`, `publishedCount: 0`, `object/notes_ticket` `INVALID_METADATA` plus `view/notes_ticket.open` `BATCH_ABORTED`; no `unhiddenApps` or `unhideError`; the stored app is still `_unpublished: true`; nothing is announced.
  - A pre-flight refusal (an object without the declared `notes_` namespace prefix): `NAMESPACE_PREFIX`, with the same three facts.
  - CONTROL `published`: it flips, and announces `view/notes_open` and `app/notes_desk`.
  - CONTROL `nothing_to_publish`: it flips, and announces `app/notes_desk`.
  - The harness's `boot()` gained optional `channel` / `namespace` arguments, defaulting to its old values, and `context.trigger` is now a spy.
- `http-dispatcher.test.ts`, beside the existing ADR-0045 flip cases, with protocol doubles:
  - A `refused` answer: no `getMetaItems`, no `saveMetaItem`, no `unhiddenApps`, no announce, and `outcome` and the causal code passed through.
  - Fail closed: an answer with no `outcome`, and one with `outcome: 'partial'`, flip nothing.

Doubles changed, test-only and value-only: 10 protocol doubles in 5 runtime test files answered the pre-#10462 shape with no `outcome`, and each expects a flip. Each now also carries `outcome: 'published'`. The value follows the double's own `success: true` under the pinned invariant `success === (outcome === 'published')`. Nothing else in those tests changed. The files are `http-dispatcher.test.ts` (5), `meta-write-org-scope.test.ts` (2), `packages-flip-announce-disclosure.test.ts` (1), `packages-unpublished-reflag-protection.test.ts` (1) and `packages-write-actor-session.test.ts` (1). Step 0 counted 4 files: the fifth, `packages-write-actor-session.test.ts`, had been missed because it already spelled `outcome` elsewhere. It is a test of this door, inside the Claim's "packages.ts and its tests".

The three edited suites that reach the dispatcher's lazy `@objectstack/metadata` load (`packages-flip-announce-disclosure.test.ts`, `packages-unpublished-reflag-protection.test.ts` and this harness) also gain the module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata';`. That is what `check:test-source-alias` prescribes for every test file a change edits: the first load is paid at collection, not inside a clocked case. No assertion changes.

<details><summary>Reproduction on main before the change (f0f729e7, which carries #32454): the real door, the real producer and SQLite</summary>

The app was saved active with `_unpublished: true`. The drafts were a view, then an object with the `QJ{YYYYMM}-{0000}` autonumber format (`environment` channel), and separately an unprefixed object under a declared namespace. The responses and the stored rows after:

```
refused, rollback   :: status 200, outcome refused, publishedCount 0, failed [view BATCH_ABORTED, object INVALID_METADATA], unhiddenApps ["leave_management"], stored app _unpublished: false
refused, pre-flight :: status 200, outcome refused, publishedCount 0, failed [object NAMESPACE_PREFIX], unhiddenApps ["leave_management"], stored app _unpublished: false
nothing_to_publish  :: status 200, outcome nothing_to_publish, publishedCount 0, unhiddenApps ["leave_management"], stored app _unpublished: false
```

The first two are the defect. The third is the ADR-0045 additive publish, which must keep flipping.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the guard removed once, on the committed fix (723f6d78)</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts --anchor "PUBLISH_OUTCOMES_THAT_FLIP.has((result as any)?.outcome) &&" --delete`. Anchor x1 → x0, blob `29dc2a6d33e5` → `920d1be6622f`. The suites import the door from `src/`, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

```
× POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts runs no visibility flip after a REFUSED publish, and announces nothing
× POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts flips nothing on an answer that names no refusal-free outcome — it fails closed
× a publish refused at a LATER draft (the rollback) leaves the app hidden: no flip, no `unhiddenApps`, no announce
× a PRE-FLIGHT refusal leaves the app hidden as well
Test Files  2 failed (2)
     Tests  4 failed | 260 passed (264)
AssertionError: expected "vi.fn()" to not be called at all, but actually been called 1 times
AssertionError: expected { success: false, …(6) } to not have property "unhiddenApps"
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (29dc2a6d33e5) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

The two CONTROL pins (`published`, `nothing_to_publish`) stay green, which is the expected direction.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Census.** First-party callers of the door are the Studio and Console callers in `ui/`: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `PackagesPage.tsx`, `usePublishAllDrafts.ts`, `PendingDraftsBar.tsx` and `AiChatPage.tsx`, all through `data-objectstack`'s `MetadataClient.publishPackageDrafts`. The other caller is `@objectstack/client`'s `packages.publishDrafts`. None of them reads `unhiddenApps` (repo-wide grep: CHANGELOG and doc text only). **cloud `service-ai-studio` (which ADR-0045 names as a consumer) could not be checked from this repository.**
- **Response shape unchanged.** `unhiddenApps` was already optional, "present ONLY when at least one app flipped" (`PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema`), and that stays true. So no spec text moves and the `#9406` conformance pins hold.
- **Not edited, outside the file surface:** `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__runtime__src__domains__packages.ts.json` lists ADR-0045 only. This change also implements ADR-0067 D2 at the flip. Adding ADR-0067 to that anchor's `adrs` would be a separate one-line edit. Carrier: seat.
- **Measured on the way, not a finding:** under the `package-author` authoring channel the publish-time authoring gate does not run, so the `{YYYYMM}` format publishes there. That is by design (`protocol-authoring-gate.ts`: "a caller has to claim to BE the package author"), which is why the rollback pin boots the `environment` channel.
